items.description: Isla Tiburón in Sonora is Mexico's largest island and an important conservation area for the indigenous Seri people.
The Marietas Islands in Nayarit are a national park, famous for the hidden 'Playa del Amor' and rich marine life.
Isla Contoy in Quintana Roo is an uninhabited nature reserve and a crucial nesting ground for seabirds.
The Tequila agave fields in Jalisco are a UNESCO World Heritage site and the source of the famous Mexican tequila.
Valle de Guadalupe in Baja California is Mexico's premier wine region, known for its award-winning wines.
Veracruz coffee farms are renowned for their high-quality coffee production and picturesque landscapes.
Chiapas coffee fincas produce some of Mexico's finest coffee in a mountainous, rain-rich region.
Oaxaca mezcal agave fields are the heart of mezcal production, a traditional Mexican spirit.
Michoacán avocado orchards make Mexico the world's largest avocado producer.
Sinaloa mango orchards are known for their abundant harvests and the high quality of exported mangoes.
